verdict.rationale: Riveter lets developers choose between a fast synchronous quick_search and slower AI-researched runs (search_agent, enrichments). It also lets them control when run results arrive: via the `wait` long-poll, polling with wait_for_result, or webhooks on run.completed, run.stopped or run.finished. This is a coarse latency-versus-depth choice rather than fine-grained control over returning partial or incomplete content early. Missing for 10: documented timeout or partial-result return semantics, explicit parameters for trading completeness against latency within one request, and hands-on corroboration.
